_notes.source: Live configurators read in Chrome on 2026-10-20: https://e8markets.com/ (Classic Markets: E8 One, E8 Pro, E8 Signature, every size) and https://e8futures.com/ (E8 Signature, E8 Zero MAX, E8 Zero Starter, every size; rules per size from the server-rendered configurator pages, default 80% payout configuration), help.e8markets.com affiliate article and https://e8markets.com/legal/affiliate. Earlier sources listed in git history.
_notes.pricing: standard = price without a code (crossed out), promo = first-order price with code E8 as displayed on 2026-10-20: Classic Markets E8 One and E8 Pro 30% off, E8 Signature 50% off; futures Signature 25% off, Zero MAX and Zero Starter 35% off. The code is first order only. A separate 'Winter ARC' code E8ARC ('up to 50% off', until 25 Oct 2026) was also advertised; not applied here. E8 One and E8 Pro prices are for the default configuration (E8 One: 6% drawdown, 80% payout; E8 Pro: 8% drawdown, 80% payout). Swap-free adds 10%; cTrader costs an extra $10 on accounts under $100.
_notes.billing: All E8 challenges are a one-time fee. The configurator shows 'No Activation Fee'. No monthly subscription. Fee refund only if the account is unused, under 30 days old and not paid in crypto (refund policy); E8 says it does not refund the fee with the first payout, so fee_refund = false.
_notes.rule_units: Forex rules are % of account size. Futures rules are fixed USD amounts.
_notes.null_means: Not stated (or varies by account size or configuration) on the official pages checked. See the notes before publishing.
_notes.forex_rules: All E8 products are single-phase. E8 One: drawdown customisable 4-14% (profit target = 1.5x drawdown, daily drawdown ~0.66x drawdown); values here are the website's default 6% configuration ($100K: $9,000 target, $6,000 dynamic drawdown, $4,000 daily drawdown). Note: the E8 One help article describes a different preset (6% target, 3% daily, 4% dynamic drawdown) - the website configurator was used because its prices match. 'Dynamic' drawdown trails closed profits only and locks at the starting balance. 40% best-day rule on the performance account only; news trading banned around high-impact news on the performance account. E8 Pro: 8% target, 8% static drawdown (moves only after first payout), 2.5% daily drawdown, 2% daily profit cap counts toward target and payouts, no consistency, daily payouts with 1% minimum profit; payout split 80% or 100% (paid add-on). E8 Signature (Classic Markets): 6% target, end-of-day dynamic drawdown of 4% on $25K and $50K and 3% on $100K and $150K ($1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500), so max_loss is left null; no daily limit in the challenge, a 2% soft 'daily pause' on the performance account only; 35% best-day rule on payouts; payout caps per payout ($1,000-$5,250) and a buffer equal to the drawdown. All forex products: unlimited time, but at least one trade every 60 days.
_notes.futures_rules: Futures market (e8futures.com, Tradovate/NinjaTrader). E8 Signature Futures: 6% target, end-of-day dynamic drawdown ($4,000 on $150K applies to accounts bought after 1 Oct 2026), 2% daily pause on the performance account only ($500 / $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000) so daily_loss is null, 35% best-day rule on payouts, max 4 payouts per account then a free new challenge; payout_cap = cap on the 1st and 2nd payout (3rd and 4th: $1,250 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $3,500). E8 Zero Starter and Max: identical rules, differ only in price and payout caps; end-of-day dynamic drawdown (USD amounts per size now recorded as max_loss, see zero_changes_2026_10_20), no daily loss limit, 40% best-day rule in the challenge only, no consistency/minimum days on the performance account, daily payouts ($100 minimum), max 4 payouts per account; payout split 80% or 100%. max_contracts = challenge allowance in full-size contracts (micros = 10x); E8 Zero performance accounts start lower (2/3/4) and scale up with profit. Signature needs at least one trade every 60 days, Zero every 7 days. Positions are closed daily (Zero: 15:10 CT).
_notes.not_listed: Perpetual Futures market (E8 One and E8 Pro on E8 Terminal / Hyperliquid, crypto and other perpetuals) is not listed separately; it uses the same E8 One / E8 Pro prices with a bigger first-order discount (50%). The free trial (E8 Trial One) is also not listed.
_notes.company: Footer: E8 Funding LLC, 4101 McEwen Rd #205, Dallas, TX (operates TradeLocker, cTrader, Match-Trader); E8 Markets Ltd, Saint Lucia, reg. 2025-00347 (operates MT5); website subject to the policies of Digital Renaissance LLC (Puerto Rico). Founded 2021 as E8 Funding (help centre).
_notes.company_check: Founded 2021 as E8 Funding (E8 help centre, see source). HQ from the site footer: E8 Funding LLC, 4101 McEwen Rd #205, Dallas, TX. No Google Maps listing for E8 Markets found (2026-10-20).
_notes.zero_changes_2026_10_20: E8 Zero Starter is now sold as $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K ($128 / $218 / $338 / $438), replacing the earlier $50K / $100K / $200K at $178 / $278 / $558. E8 Zero MAX added a $25K ($228). Rules per size from the configurator (80% payout setting): profit target $1,500 / $3,000 / $6,500 / $9,000 (Starter 150K) or $13,500 (MAX 200K); EOD dynamic drawdown $1,000 / $1,500 / $3,000 / $3,990 (Starter 150K) / $6,000 (MAX 200K), recorded as max_loss. Max contracts and payout caps for the new sizes are not shown, so null.
_notes.min_trading_days: E8 Signature (forex and futures) can be passed 'in as little as 1 day' (configurator), so min_trading_days = 0, as for E8 One.
_notes.affiliate_program: help.e8markets.com and https://e8markets.com/legal/affiliate (Global Affiliate Program, updated 25 Nov 2025; checked 2026-10-20): one account, link and discount code across forex, futures and crypto. Level 1 - open to anyone with at least one social media link, auto-approved: 20% on a customer's first sale, 10% on later sales and resets. Level 2 - interview only, 25% / 12.5%, and restricted to individual content creators, NOT comparison, review or blog websites. Discount codes may not be shared on coupon sites, forums or by spam. Minimum payout $200, first payout no sooner than 28 days after registration or the last payout, commissions from at least 3 unique users between payouts; payment method and cookie length not stated. No country rule stated. Apply: via the affiliate dashboard linked from the help centre.

firm.name: E8 Markets
firm.about: E8 Markets sells single-phase simulated trading challenges for forex/CFD and futures traders, with several rule sets to choose from and accounts from $5K to $500K. It started in 2021 as E8 Funding and is based in Dallas, Texas.

countries.notes: E8 publishes separate lists for its two products. The 31 above are blocked for both forex (Classic Markets) and futures - this includes the UAE. Forex is also blocked for Midway Islands, Samoa, Vatican City and Western Sahara. Futures is also blocked in 56 more countries plus Crimea: Angola, Antarctica, Bahamas, Barbados, Bosnia, Botswana, Bulgaria, Burkina Faso, Cambodia, Cameroon, Chad, China, Côte d'Ivoire, Croatia, Djibouti, Ghana, Gibraltar, Guinea-Bissau, Haiti, Iceland, Indonesia, Jamaica, Jordan, Kenya, Laos, Lesotho, Liberia, North Macedonia, Malawi, Mauritius, Mongolia, Montenegro, Mozambique, Namibia, Nigeria, Panama, Papua New Guinea, Philippines, Qatar, Romania, Rwanda, Senegal, Serbia, Sierra Leone, Slovenia, South Africa, Sri Lanka, Tajikistan, Tanzania, Timor-Leste, Trinidad and Tobago, Tunisia, Turkey, Uganda, Vietnam and Zimbabwe. E8 One is not sold to Bangladesh, Bulgaria, Cambodia, Croatia, Laos, Romania or Taiwan, and is capped at $200K for India, Indonesia, Kenya and Vietnam. US residents can't use MT5 or cTrader (TradeLocker and Match-Trader only). Country is taken from the ID document used for verification. 'XK' (Kosovo) and 'PS' (listed as West Bank / Palestine) are the codes commonly used for those places.
